headline: Stage 5K can start a shadow scheduler, but that is not the combined route. Normal-R4 and NKD are decided by LEGACY jobs, and the STOP_TRADING an operator must place to freeze legacy freezes them too. A first shadow period under the 5J/5K flow measures Calm + Stress ONLY.

roska4_swing / Normal-R4.gap: legacy is ema 30 / chandelier 2.5 / ratchet ON; Track 1 is ema 50 / entry-anchored 2.0x ATR / ratchet OFF / arm 14:05. Different strategies. The Track 1 module exists (track1_normal_r4, reproduces 1223 rows exactly) but has NO slot

global_nkd / MNKD.gap: the STRATEGY matches - ema 10, chandelier 2.5, hold 5, RegimeLabels(lag_days=1) - so this is a wiring/ownership job, not a promotion. The BOOK and caps are legacy's

roska4_calm.stop: ATR15 disaster stop, risk from true stop distance
roska4_calm.gap: needs a real bar provider on a live day; never connected

preflight.morning_slots: Calm 10:00 and Stress 10:35-12:30 all fire BEFORE 13:45, so they decide on D-1 stored bars plus today's live bars via the provider - the designed contract, not a defect
preflight.pre_market_refresh_needed: no; adding one would be a deliberate change
preflight.action: promote to a SHARED job owned by neither route before retiring legacy

shared_and_DANGEROUS: global_index/maxhold_state.json - one file, two routes would overwrite each other's already-ran-today marker

account_level_cannot_be_split: orphan working STP - an order carries no route

migration_plan.name: shared pre-flight
migration_plan.gate: both routes read the same preflight_state
migration_plan.rollback: revert the job name; the body is unchanged

migration_plan.name: promote Normal-R4
migration_plan.gate: shadow rows for the swing window match the measured book day for day
migration_plan.rollback: drop the slots; legacy keeps running the window

migration_plan.name: own NKD
migration_plan.work: Track 1 night slots; strategy already matches
migration_plan.gate: NKD shadow rows match legacy's decisions on the same nights

migration_plan.name: route-aware safety
migration_plan.work: stop repair + max-hold per route; split maxhold_state
migration_plan.gate: a Track 1 position gets a stop repaired and a max-hold exit in a dry run
migration_plan.rollback: legacy paths unchanged; the Track 1 pair is additive

migration_plan.name: full Track 1 shadow
migration_plan.gate: coverage complete every trading day, all four sleeves; checkpoint accepted

migration_plan.name: retire legacy jobs
migration_plan.work: remove legacy entry slots; keep shared infra
migration_plan.gate: B1 recorded; legacy flat at the broker; no orphan STP
migration_plan.rollback: restore the legacy slots from git

blockers.title: Track 1 Normal-R4 has no production slot, and legacy's swing is a DIFFERENT strategy
blockers.evidence: legacy run_live_day: ema 30, chandelier 2.5, ratchet ON (NKD_EMA/SWING_TF_PARAM); Track1 NormalR4Params: ema 50, entry-anchored 2.0x ATR, ratchet OFF, arm 14:05. run_live_day_track1 documents the resulting checkpoint params_mismatch as correct.
blockers.impact: the 23 live_day slots (14:05-15:55) produce LEGACY swing, not Track 1's Normal-R4. Track 1's largest sleeve has no live path at all
blockers.fix: promote Normal-R4 into Track 1 slots covering 14:05-15:55, as Calm/Stress were

blockers.title: STOP_TRADING freezes two of Track 1's four sleeves
blockers.evidence: Normal-R4's window is served by legacy live_day slots and NKD's by legacy nkd_night slots; both run run_live_day, whose D5 gate clears entry_candidates when STOP_TRADING is present
blockers.impact: the Stage 5J/5K operator flow - STOP_TRADING then --track1-shadow - measures Calm and Stress ONLY. It is not the combined route, and coverage collected under it cannot support a combined-book claim
blockers.fix: either promote Normal/NKD to Track 1 slots first, or state explicitly that the first shadow period is a Calm+Stress-only measurement

blockers.title: Safety jobs are hard-wired to the legacy positions file
blockers.evidence: captured argv: run_maxhold_exit --positions-path live_positions.json; run_stop_repair --positions-path live_positions.json
blockers.impact: a Track 1 position in live_positions.track1.json would get NO stop repair and NO max-hold exit. The two mechanisms that protect a multi-day position do not see it
blockers.fix: route-aware stop repair and max-hold, or a second pair of route-scoped jobs

blockers.title: One IB login is one position book (B1, unchanged)
blockers.evidence: IBKRBroker.get_positions() reads ib.positions() unfiltered; B3 reconciles per contract
blockers.impact: legacy LONG 1 beside Track 1 SHORT 1 nets to zero and halts entries on BOTH routes
blockers.fix: retire legacy first, or a separate account

blockers.title: Track 1 caps/family guard are not applied to the legacy-run sleeves
blockers.evidence: track1_params CAPS/FAMILY_GROSS 0.05/FAMILY_NET 0.044 are enforced by track1_signal_layer, which only the Track 1 slots reach; legacy uses its own MultiClusterGuard in run_live_day
blockers.impact: while Normal/NKD are legacy-run, the combined book is capped by legacy's guard, not Track 1's - the two are not the same object and have not been reconciled
blockers.fix: whichever route owns a sleeve must own its cap; reconcile the two guards before mixing

blockers.title: Pre-flight is a legacy job that Track 1 depends on
blockers.evidence: the single `preflight` job at 13:45 ET runs update_ibkr_daily + update_spy_csv and writes preflight_state.json; track1_freshness encodes the D-1 13:45 contract
blockers.impact: retiring legacy jobs wholesale would remove the data refresh Track 1's freshness gate is defined against, and every Track 1 slot would refuse
blockers.fix: promote pre-flight to a SHARED production job owned by neither route

blockers.title: Morning Track 1 slots trade on D-1 data by contract
blockers.evidence: required_data_through(): before 13:45 ET the answer is the previous business day; Calm fires 10:00 and Stress 10:35-12:30, all before 13:45
blockers.impact: this is the DESIGNED contract, not a defect - but it means Calm/Stress decide on yesterday's parquet plus today's live bars through the provider. If anyone expects a pre-market refresh, it does not exist
blockers.fix: none required; state it, or add a pre-market refresh as a deliberate change

blockers.title: The running scheduler predates all Track 1 work
blockers.impact: any Track 1 change is inert until it is restarted; it also runs pre-Track-1 legacy code
blockers.fix: restart --scheduler --track1-shadow when the operator is ready

verdict_reason: 8 blockers, 5 of which block legacy retirement. The largest: Track 1's Normal-R4 has no slot and legacy's swing is a different strategy, so the combined book cannot be run or measured by either route today.
